title: Ancient Meitei hymns - Wikipedia
text: Ancient Meitei hymns are traditional ritual chants originating from the Meitei people of Manipur in Northeast India. Composed in the Meitei language, these hymns form a part of the Meitei folklore associated primarily with Sanamahism, the indigenous religion of the Meitei.
